remarks: Many Andhra Pradesh state-government domains (ap.gov.in apex, and subdomains such as apindustries.gov.in, labour.ap.gov.in, ipb.ap.gov.in, dic.ap.gov.in, singledesk.ap.gov.in, factories.ap.gov.in, dof.ap.gov.in, goir.ap.gov.in, aponline.gov.in) could not be reached this session — curl returned connection resets or 502 gateway failures on every attempt, including retries. One ap.gov.in subdomain (spsnellore.ap.gov.in, a district portal) WAS reachable and returned real content, so this is not a blanket proxy block on the whole .ap.gov.in zone, but it does mean several of the most centrally relevant portals for this state/service (the AP Industries Single Desk Portal, the AP Labour/Factories Department site, and the AP e-Gazette) could not be independently verified via curl in this session, despite being named by secondary/commercial sources as the real official venues for AP factory licensing.

apegazette.cgg.gov.in (the AP e-Gazette, where Factories Rules amendments are officially notified) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; this looks like a bot/browser check rather than the page being down. Per instructions, no user-agent spoofing or other bot-check circumvention was attempted (the sandbox's permission system explicitly blocked an attempt to set a custom browser User-Agent header as 'Bot Check Circumvention'), so this source could not be verified and was excluded rather than worked around.

Two central-government domains (dgfasli.gov.in — Directorate General Factory Advice Service & Labour Institutes — and cgg.gov.in — Centre for Good Governance, which hosts several AP e-governance systems) returned HTTP 200 with real content, but neither page's home content was specifically about Andhra Pradesh factory licensing, so per the spec's relevance test they were left out of verifiedSources entirely rather than forced in; they are not listed in excluded either since they did not fail verification, they were simply judged not relevant/specific enough.

Given the state-domain connectivity problems, the verified list here is thinner than ideal for a full Factory License workflow (no verified fee schedule, no verified application form/checklist PDF, no verified Factories Rules gazette text). The two verified sources are: (1) the central NSWS portal home, which lists Andhra Pradesh among its State Approvals and is the documented route for central+state approvals including factory registration, and (2) a genuine AP government district page (SPS Nellore) that describes the Factories Department's licensing function, governing rules, and contacts in detail. Re-attempting the excluded apindustries.gov.in / labour.ap.gov.in / apegazette.cgg.gov.in URLs from a different network path in a later session is recommended before this list is treated as exhaustive.
